Name: Vyranity's Lovebirds BFAV
Author: vyranity
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]This mod adds a new animal called the [color=#00ff00]lovebird[/color].
There are 3 variants of this animal:
[color=#00ff00]-Green[/color]
[color=#ffff00]-Yellow[/color]
[color=#00ffff]-Blue[/color]

This mod also provides [color=#00ffff]3[/color] new items:
[spoiler]
[color=#ffe599]- Lovebird Egg:[/color] ﻿ ﻿      The main produce item of the Lovebird.
[color=#ffd966]- Lovebird Mayonnaise:[/color] ﻿Acquired by putting the Lovebird Egg in a Mayonnaise Machine.
[color=#00ff00]- Lovebird Bracelet[/color] ﻿       The deluxe produce item of the Lovebird.
[/spoiler]

[/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]If there are ways in which you think this mod could be improved, definately tell me in the comments :D[/size][/font]
